name: bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one
statement: bernoulli'PowerSeries A * (exp A - 1) = X * exp A

name: sum_bernoulli
statement: ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (n.choose k : ℚ) * bernoulli k) = if n = 1 then 1 else 0

name: bernoulli_spec'
statement: ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ antidiagonal n, ((k.1 + k.2).choose k.2 : ℚ) / (k.2 + 1) * bernoulli k.1) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

name: sum_range_pow
statement: ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : ℚ) ^ p) = ∑ i ∈ range (p + 1), bernoulli i * ((p + 1).choose i) * (n : ℚ) ^ (p + 1 - i) / (p + 1)

name: sum_Ico_pow
statement: ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ Ico 1 (n + 1), (k : ℚ) ^ p) = ∑ i ∈ range (p + 1), bernoulli' i * (p + 1).choose i * (n : ℚ) ^ (p + 1 - i) / (p + 1)
